item.title: Why The Bali 5.4 Should be Your Next Charter
item.description: The Bali 5.4 brings together space, comfort, and performance all in an impeccably designed 54-foot catamaran perfect for charter vacations. This yacht was built with a focus on open bright living spaces, comfortable accommodations, and plentiful outdoor spaces. With room for up to 12 in its six-cabin configuration, the Bali 5.4 is perfect for social sailing. Dream Yacht guests have the option to enjoy this yacht through a cabin cruise or when the yacht has availability outside of cabin charters, book it as a crewed yacht charter for an exclusive experience with family and friends. A Layout Designed for Living The center of the Bali 5.4’s design was built around bringing people together while still allowing space to spread out. Fluid flowing spaces from bow to stern creates seamless connection between the outdoor living areas, saloon, and aft cockpit. One of the most distinctive and innovative features of this yacht is the large pivoting rear door. It excellently connects the salon with the aft cockpit creating one extended living area and allowing for a larger conversation space. Another unique feature is the sliding windows that allow for more airflow and light giving an open air feel throughout. Forward of the saloon a door provides easy access to the foredeck. Here cushioned seats stretch out into the sun allowing guests to relax and enjoy the views while underway. While the aft cockpit provides a perfect gathering space for lunch or dinner at anchor with comfortable seating. The davits and swim ladder on the stern provide an easy access to the water for swimming. Then above there is a flybridge with a large U shaped seating area perfect for sipping a morning coffee with the sunrise or sundowners after a rewarding day of cruising. Forward of the seating area find the sunbathing pads where guests can lounge while taking in the breathtaking scenery of one of Dream Yacht’s incredible destinations. This Bali 5.4 provides so many areas where connection to the natural world and each other become possible. Find peace and shared experiences through innovation and exploration aboard this yacht. Take the Tour Comfortable Accommodations Below Deck The Bali 5.4 continues to deliver through its focus on comfort as we move below deck. Each cabin is equipped with queen sized beds, a private bathroom with a shower, and adequate storage space. Natural light and airflow are still features even down in the cabins; some cabins even have direct access to the deck. For large groups this layout is meant to give everyone their own private space at night, while relishing the communal spaces during the day. Guests get the feeling of home and settling in through these comfortable areas instead of the fleeting feeling of a hotel room. Why Charter the Bali 5.4 Space for Everyone – Roughly 130 square meters of living space allows for plenty of room to dine, relax, and enjoy cruising without feeling crowded. Indoor/Outdoor Living – The yacht’s flow from bow to stern and one of a kind opening door from the saloon to the aft cabin makes it easy to roam between the interior and exterior living spaces. Enjoy the breeze blowing through the yacht which creates a light airy open feel that connects you to the natural beauty of the surrounding world. Relaxation Area Options – There is no shortage of lounging areas onboard from the flybridge to the foredeck choose your ideal spot to enjoy the sail from. Now Newly Available for Private Crewed Charters When a Bali 5.4 is not being used on a cabin charter it will be available for a private crewed charter experience with a captain and hostess. This means families or groups of friends can experience the entire yacht privately, with a professional crew taking care of the sailing, itinerary, food, and day to day operation. Allowing guests to concentrate on relaxation and taking in the scenery from any of the comfortable lounging areas. item.title: BVI Vacation Without Sailing Experience: Best Yacht Charter Options for Beginners
item.description: Picture waking up to the sound of waves against the hull of a catamaran anchored in a secluded cove in the British Virgin Islands (BVI). Walk on deck and soak up the sunshine and the spectacular views this area is famous for. It’s the perfect holiday, and the best part is that no sailing experience is needed. With Dream Yacht Worldwide , you can enjoy a BVI yacht vacation without having to know a jib from a mainsail. We make sailing accessible to all, with three options especially suited for beginners: Easy Crew, Skippered, and Cabin Cruises. Can You Go on a BVI Vacation Without Sailing Experience? Many people assume that exploring the ocean requires a formal captain’s license or a deep understanding of marine navigation. While renting a boat entirely on your own, known as a bareboat charter , requires sailing experience, there are plenty of ways to enjoy the sea without any technical knowledge. With a crewed BVI sailing vacation , you don’t need to stress about managing a vessel. Our team oversees managing the necessary tasks, such as tracking the weather, anchoring in a busy bay, or interpreting complex nautical terms. You’ll have experienced staff managing onboard systems for you while you enjoy the experience. Our modern catamarans are also stable boats, which means a very low risk of motion sickness and a comfortable stay for those new to life on the water. Best BVI Charter Options If You Don’t Know How to Sail Every traveler has a different preference when it comes to privacy, budget, and daily schedules. Dream Yacht Worldwide provides three distinct entry points designed to match your personal style. Best For Privacy Level Meals Budget Skippered Charter Families and friend groups High (Full private yacht) Cook your own meals or dine ashore Mid to High Easy Crewed Charter Milestone trips and relaxation seekers High (Full private yacht) Half or full board cooked by a host Premium Cabin Cruise Couples, solo travelers, and budget travelers Private cabin, shared deck Set meal plan included in the price Affordable BVI Skippered Yacht Charters: Ultimate Freedom and Privacy A skippered charter means you rent an entire yacht for your group and hire a professional captain to sail it. You have total control over your daily schedule, allowing you to choose exactly when to sail and which bays to visit. The captain handles all the physical labor, anchoring, and navigation, while you and your guests enjoy the exclusive use of the boat. A BVI catamaran charter with skipper is ideal for families who want to cook their own meals or try local beachside restaurants every night. BVI Crewed Yacht Charters: The Effortless Private Getaway If you want the ultimate luxury of a private boat combined with the service of an all-inclusive resort, consider an Easy Crewed charter . Along with a professional captain, you get a dedicated onboard host/cook to manage the galley and handle tasks like grocery shopping (provisioning) or cooking meals during your stay. Cabin Cruises: The Budget-Friendly Entry Point to Sailing A Cabin Cruise is a smart choice for those who want to experience the yachting lifestyle without renting an entire boat. You can book an individual, private cabin with its own bathroom on a large, modern catamaran. The journey follows a pre-planned route, and meals are prepared and served by the crew. Think of it as staying at a boutique hotel that drops anchor at a different, beautiful spot every day. Why the BVI Is Ideal for First-Time Yacht Vacations The British Virgin Islands are widely considered the sailing capital of the Caribbean. The unique geography of the region creates a gentle, welcoming environment for anyone new to the water. Line-of-Sight Navigation and Calm Waters One of the biggest comfort factors in the BVI is that you can almost always see the next island on the horizon. item.title: Four Places You Can Rediscover the True Spirit of Adventure
item.description: For your next vacation, turn up the dial on adventure by handing over your itinerary research to us. When you book one of our yacht charter packages, you’ll enjoy photo-worthy highlights, exciting excursions, delicious cuisine and memorable experiences carefully selected by our destination specialists. In your downtime you can relax on a premium yacht with spacious lounge and deck areas before retreating to your private double cabin with its own bathroom. There are +15 destinations to choose from for our boat charter vacations , including the Caribbean, Indian Ocean, Pacific, Asia and Mediterranean. You’ll get to make new like-minded friends as you set off on an experience of a lifetime while our captain and chef will look after you. Get to know our latest routes… Extended vacation in the Grenadines Following the popularity of our Dream Grenadines premium 8 day charter , we’ve listened to requests for an extended tour of the Grenadines and introduced our new Dream Grenadines Premium 11 day charter . Your vacation will stop by: Martinique Bequia Mustique Tobago Cays and the marine park Petite St. Vincent Morpion Mayreau Palm Island Union St. Vincent Canouan Saint Lucia Saint Anne Optional excursions include: Mustique island tour and swim at Macaroni beach, lobster BBQ at Tobago Cays and visit to a local bar to hear a steel band, tour of St. Vincent and swim under a cascade of water, tour of St. Lucia including volcano crater, sulfur springs and botanical gardens. The Grenadines is such a wonderful part of the world with much to see and do without traveling far. Get your Caribbean sun booked in for this year and then all you have to do is check out the flights and pack your bags. Our new treat in Tahiti We’ve been offering French Polynesia by the cabin charters for a while with our Papeete 11 day charter , Huahine 4 day charter and Bora Bora 4 days and 8 day charters . New for 2018, we’ve added our Rangiroa Dream 6 day charter . Now you can explore Tahiti’s Tuamotus archipelago with its sandy motus, coral gardens and bounty of marine life to snorkel. During your vacation, you will discover: Mahanahana for kayaking and snorkeling Kauraufara fishing village and shell beach Sables Rose and coral garden Motu Teu and Bird Island with its thousands of birds Otepipi, a deserted village Motu Faama Blue lagoon and marine life Tiputa Pass and dolphin watching Tahiti is a special place full of romance where you can enjoy peace and quiet away from crowds and let us spoil you. New Cabin Charters in the Bahamas We’ve recently announced our new Exumas Dream 8 day charter from Nassau. It’s just a short hop before you hit the first of the Exumas cays where you’ll be met with white-sand beaches, surprising wildlife, protected marine reserves, Hollywood movie sets and even a former drug baron’s hideout. Your charter package includes visiting: Palm cay Highbourne Cay Allen Cay Warderick Wells Cay & Exuma Cays Land & Sea Park Staniel Cay Big Major Spot Bay with the swimming pigs Thunderball grotto Shroud Cay Norman’s Cay This region is famous for its stromatolite reefs, some of the oldest living examples on earth, as well as coral reefs teeming with tropical fish. Relax in the Balearic Islands If you want a European experience, head to Mallorca for our Palma Dream 8 day charter . You’ll find a relaxed pace of life, fantastic weather (with 300 sunny days annually) and a tour of the archipelago off Spain’s Iberian peninsula with 500km of coastline. Your cruise will include: Palma Cala Portal Vells Cala Pi Colonia Sant Jordi Cala Figuera Porto Petro Cala Santanyi Cabrera Es Trenc Beach Sa Rapita You’ll find golden beaches, medieval history, gothic cathedrals, quaint fishing ports and clear waters that are perfect for swimming and snorkeling. Learn more Take a look at our by the cabin charters , or get in touch with our team. Email us at [email protected] or give us a call at 855.650.8902. Share: Link Copied to Clipboard

item.title: Hotspots for scuba diving in Thailand
item.description: While Thailand may be best known for its tropical climate, white sand beaches, rich culture and delicious cuisine, scuba divers know it as a world-class diving and snorkeling destination. The stunning waters of Thailand are home to over 300 islands, 1200 miles of coastline and hundreds of incredibly diverse dive sites. From impressive wrecks to pristine reefs to colorful coral-encrusted walls, scuba diving in Thailand will delight every diver from novice to expert. One of the most exciting ways to experience diving in Thailand is from aboard a private sailing charter, where you can avoid the crowded day charter boats and dive directly from your liveaboard yacht. The Dream Yacht Charter base is located in Yacht Haven Marina on the island of Phuket that extends down into southeast Thailand’s Andaman Sea – where most of Thailand’s top dive and snorkeling spots can be found. Scuba diving in Thailand is known and loved for exceptional underwater visibility, varied marine life and some of the best coral to be found anywhere in the world. And if you’re anything like the many divers looking to experience a thrilling dive with whale sharks and manta rays, the Andaman Sea can provide the dive experience of a lifetime. When putting together your itinerary for scuba diving in Thailand, consider the time of year, your dive experience, and the types of activities you enjoy most – whether you want to swim with tiger sharks, snorkel along scenic beaches, or macro dive and linger among rare tiny sea critters. When diving the Andaman Sea, visiting between October and April is ideal, when seas are calmer and visibility is at its best. To help you plan, we’ve put together our list of favorite hotspots for scuba diving in Thailand. Read on to find your diving bliss! Phi Phi Islands A NOVICE DIVERS PLAYGROUND The Phi Phi Islands are stunningly beautiful both above and below the surface. With its sparkling bays and crescent beaches surrounded by stunning rock formations, it’s one of the most photographed areas of Thailand. It’s worth a visit for the above-water scenery alone, but for divers the underwater experience is a must. With striking coral gardens, caverns, and swim-throughs, along with calm novice-friendly bays, it offers some of the most thrilling diving for beginners. Keep an eye out for leopard sharks that are often seen here. Koh Phi Phi is also a great option for those interested in snorkeling in Thailand. Check out the main island of Koh Phi Phi Don for amazing snorkeling at both Nui Beach and Long Beach. Phuket CONVENIENT GATEWAY TO THAILAND DIVING Phuket is often overlooked when considering the many options for scuba diving in Thailand. But Phuket’s coastline offers a surprising variety of dives with dramatic underwater landscapes, excellent visibility and easy conditions. And it’s one of the best places in Thailand for those interested in shore diving for beginners. Visit the popular Koh Dok Mai dive site to see extraordinary yellow tube corals and numerous eels. More experienced divers will enjoy Shark Point, known for beautiful leopard shark sightings. Richelieu Rock AN ADVANCED DIVER’S PARADISE Some say the Richelieu Rock dive site offers the best scuba diving in Thailand. This pinnacle site is located north of the Similan Islands, and is fairly remote, taking a bit longer to reach. But it’s well known for whale shark sightings, with the best time of year to spot them being between February and May. And even if you don’t spot the whale sharks, Richelieu Rock has much more to offer, including manta rays, walls of yellow anemones, and macro critters like sea horses, and porcelain crabs. Keep in mind that Richelieu Rock is best for advanced divers, due to the open water swells and strong currents.
